envelope.author: AssayOmpGuardPrecise2
envelope.reason: On omp the guard now judges a call only in the persona's own main session, so no act is judged against a contract other than its performer's: a subagent goes unjudged and silent, and a session that cannot say which it is goes unjudged with a notice to the operator naming the guard. Every refusal on a refusing event is judged afresh on each fire, and the judge is handed the rubric and the worker's payload alone, with no added framing; both rubrics state their own output format. The repair only makes the canon purview test fire the module as a main session, which the shard requires, and the omp adapter tests (72 of 72) and the canon purview guardrail tests (47 of 47) pass at the commit, which merges cleanly onto the line at 994335b0. The installed omp 18.4.5 carries the session signal.
envelope.cause: assay of omp-guard-precise at e70418d1 against enforcement scope, after the broke report on 79e6f36c and OmpGuardPrecise2's repair

spec.name: omp-guard-precise
spec.intent:
Census @cbac6a5f (plan/purview-routes: closed, unreleased as PR #42, and it changes this unit's files over main 15d0a621); re-derive any line cited below if its path changed since.
BASE. This unit's branch must hold cbac6a5f before any change: unless `git merge-base --is-ancestor cbac6a5f HEAD` succeeds, merge plan/purview-routes into it first, so the work stands on that line's omp message mapping and the plan line meets no conflict when PR #42 lands.
Realize on omp two clauses of `enforcement scope` as amended 2026-09-30T21:21: a guard judges an act against the contract of the agent that performs it, and where a harness cannot tell which agent is running the guard is not enforced and the operator is told; and what a guard hands its judge is only its test (the rubric) and the act and contract it applies to (the worker's payload).
AT CENSUS. The persona guard module is generated by packages/forge/src/adapters/omp/render.ts. A judging registration returns before its worker runs when `inSubagent(ctx)` (L670), and `inSubagent` (L793-794) reads `ctx.agent !== undefined && ctx.agent.kind !== "main"`, so a context carrying no `agent` is judged against the persona's contract whichever session it came from. In the installed omp 18.4.5 (~/.local/bin/omp) the extension runner is built with `kind: nn ? "sub" : "main"`, where `nn = (e.taskDepth ?? 0) > 0 || Boolean(e.parentTaskPrefix)`, and a spawned subagent loads its parent's extension paths [read from the binary; not yet observed in a live session]. Kino's session whose subagents were judged by kino's contract (SupplyK2g, 2026-09-30T14:08Z) was started at 07:53 local, before 0.7.3, which added the skip, was installed at 08:53 [inferred from process and file times]. askJudge (L1011-1109) sends the judge the payload wrapped as `=== BEGIN TRANSCRIPT EXCERPT (operator instruction + agent turn) === … Apply the rubric. Output ONLY the verdict block.` (L1063), which labels a purview payload (a contract and an act) as a transcript. The comments at L633-639, L643-644 and L1150 rest on the stance worker's no-progress detector, its loop safety and a re-entry cap, all removed by units stance-guard-precise, pre-call-refusal-holds and purview-guard-precise (the Stop worker already judges a turn whatever `stop_hook_active` says).
CHANGE. A judging registration runs its worker only when `ctx.agent?.kind === "main"`. A subagent session is judged by nothing and says nothing, as now. A context with no `agent` is judged by nothing, and the module relays, by the path it relays a worker's let-through notice (L1111 on), one line naming the guard and saying it could not tell which session is running, so the call was not judged. askJudge sends the worker's payload alone as the user message, with no label and no instruction line; the rubric carries the output format. Reword the comments at L633-639, L643-644 and L1150 so that none rests on a no-progress detector, a worker's loop safety or a re-entry cap; the `stop_hook_active` field the bridge passes stays. In packages/forge/test/adapters/omp.test.ts, contexts that stand for a main session carry `agent: {kind: "main", …}`, and the stub worker mode `noprogress` (L619, L771), a notice no worker prints once this plan lands, is removed. Keep JUDGE_TIMEOUT_MS, JUDGE_MISS_LIMIT, JUDGE_COOLDOWN_MS, the act bindings and the message mapping unchanged. Add .changeset/omp-guard-precise.md (@cratylus/forge patch).
accept: SESSION: a case in packages/forge/test/adapters/omp.test.ts loads the module ompGuardrailExtensions generates for a persona binding tool.use.pre, on a worker stub that counts its fires, and fires one tool_call with `ctx.agent` `{kind: "main", id: "0-main", depth: 0}`, one with `{kind: "sub", id: "0-Child", parentId: "0-main", depth: 1}` and one with no `agent`: the worker is fired once, zero times and zero times, and the third relays a line naming the guard and saying it could not tell which session is running. Against render.ts at cbac6a5f the third fires the worker, so the case fails there.

PAYLOAD ALONE: a case with a completeSimple stub that records its request finds the user message content equal, byte for byte, to the payload the worker emitted under STANCE_EMIT_PAYLOAD. At cbac6a5f it is wrapped in the transcript-excerpt label, so the case fails there.

LIVE on the installed omp (print `omp --version`; 18.4.5 at census): `omp -p --no-extensions -e <the module generated for a test persona, placed in a temp scope, whose worker command is a stub that appends the tool name of every fire to a file and allows>` with a prompt that has the main agent dispatch one `task` subagent that writes a file under a temp dir. The stub's file records the main session's `task` call and nothing from the subagent, while the subagent's file exists; print the stub's file and the written path. A model that cannot be reached prints `could not look: <why>` and the criterion is not met.
`grep -n -E 'no-progress|re-entry|loop-safety' packages/forge/src/adapters/omp/render.ts` prints nothing; at cbac6a5f it prints L638, L644 and L1150.
Green: `pnpm --filter @cratylus/forge exec vitest run test/adapters/omp.test.ts` and `pnpm --filter @cratylus/forge typecheck` exit 0.
`git diff --name-only <the unit's base holding cbac6a5f> <landed commit>` lists only paths in this unit's outputs (records/ excepted).
